name.description: A string that can be used to name a `DrsObject`.

self_uri.description: A drs:// hostname-based URI that tells clients how to access this object.

size.description: For blobs, the blob size in bytes. For bundles, the cumulative size, in bytes, of items in the `contents` field.

created_time.description: Timestamp of content creation in RFC3339.

updated_time.description: Timestamp of content update in RFC3339.

mime_type.description: A string providing the mime-type of the `DrsObject`.

checksums.description: The checksum of the `DrsObject`. At least one checksum must be provided.

access_methods.description: The list of access methods that can be used to fetch the `DrsObject`. Required for single blobs; optional for bundles.

contents.description: If set, this `DrsObject` is a bundle containing the listed `ContentsObject`s.

description.description: A human readable description of the `DrsObject`.

aliases.description: A list of strings that can be used to find other metadata about this `DrsObject`.
